title: Current for natural springs
description: Essential: Correctly calculates I = mg/(BL) = 0.4 A for part (1).

title: Spring constant calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates k = (mg - BI₁L)/(2Δx) = 24.5 N/m for part (2).

title: Stretch for reversed current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates Δx' = (mg + BI₂L)/(2k) = 0.003 m for part (3).

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: Sets up proper force balance equations considering gravity, magnetic force, and spring forces.

title: Magnetic force direction
description: Important: Correctly determines magnetic force direction relative to current direction and field orientation.

title: Spring force distribution
description: Important: Recognizes that spring forces are equal and each supports half the net force when symmetric.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Converts all quantities to consistent SI units (m, kg, s, A, T, N/m).

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for magnetic force in equations (adding when should subtract or vice versa).

title: Spring force miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Forgets to divide by 2 when calculating individual spring forces or constants.
